closedMore: Tidal water: a different regulation system. The B.C. freshwater fishing regulations do not apply here: no provincial rule, quota, closure, gear rule, licence or stamp. See the federal (DFO) tidal waters sport fishing regulations or the Fishing BC app; a federal Tidal Waters Sport Fishing Licence is required.
